risk_note: RV1 (contract only). One new planned operation, adminBatchManualPaid (W8; BR-WDR-16, 08, 09, 17, 33; D10-595): payout.manual_entry, totp step-up, idempotent, audited, each item on its own transaction with its own result. Guards follow BR-WDR-16 and reuse the query guard of the manual W3; a wechat withdrawal is refused, and an item without a verified real name is that item's result, not a 5xx. Agent defaults stated in the text: 200 items, channel_order_id 1 to 64 characters with no whitespace, paid_at at most 5 minutes after the Clock and not before created_at. Entering and confirming are one submission; 08 also allows a separate confirmation, which is not offered and is reported for a ruling. No new error code, no existing operation changes, no migration.
